Bot.summary: The official Rubika Bot API. Token based, plain HTTP JSON.

methods.name: ask
methods.signature: ask(localself, chat_id: str, text: Optional[str]=None, *, filters: Optional[list]=None, timeout: float=60.0, inline_keypad: Any=None, chat_keypad: Any=None)
methods.doc:
Send a prompt and await the next matching reply in that chat.

While the prompt is pending, the first message in the chat that
passes *filters* is returned to you instead of being dispatched to
handlers, so a two-step flow needs no state flag::

    name = await bot.ask(chat_id, "Your name?", timeout=30)

Raises:
    darkob.NoReply: when nothing arrives within ``timeout``.

``save_as=True`` returns a status dictionary with ``file_path`` and

``Data`` wrapper, which would break existing darkob callers, so its

methods.name: edit_chat_keypad
methods.signature: edit_chat_keypad(self: 'darkob.Bot', chat_id: str, chat_keypad: Optional[Union[Dict[str, Any], List[Dict[str, Any]]]], resize_keyboard: bool=True, one_time_keyboard: bool=False)
methods.doc:
Edits or adds a new chat keypad (custom keyboard) to the chat.

Parameters:
    chat_id (str): chat_id of the group (starts with 'g0') or user (starts with 'b0').
    chat_keypad (Dict[str, Any] or List): The keyboard layout to set. Supports three formats:

        1. Simple list of strings:
            [
                ["Button 1", "Button 2"],
                ["Button 3"]
            ]
            Each inner list is a row. Buttons are strings. The type is set to "Simple" and IDs are assigned automatically starting from 100.

        2. List of tuples: (button_text, button_id, button_type)
            [
                [("راهنما", "help")],
                [("تلاش مجدد", "retry"), ("بستن", "close")],
                [("پنل مدیریت", "panel", "Simple"), ("تنظیمات", "settings", "Simple")],
                [("درباره", None), ("پشتیبانی", None)],
                [("✅ تایید", "confirm"), ("❌ لغو", "cancel"), ("🔄 بازگشت", "back")],
            ]
            Tuple structure: (text, id, type) - text: button text, id: button ID (if None, auto-assigned starting from 100), type: button type (if omitted, defaults to "Simple").

        3. Full dictionary (raw API format):
            {
                "rows": [
                    {"buttons": [{"id": "1", "button_text": "Button 1", "type": "Simple"}]},
                    {"buttons": [{"id": "2", "button_text": "Button 2", "type": "Simple"}]}
                ]
            }

    resize_keyboard (bool, optional): Requests clients to resize the keyboard vertically. Defaults to True.
    one_time_keyboard (bool, optional): Requests clients to hide the keyboard as soon as it's been used. Defaults to False.

Returns:
    The API response after editing the chat keypad.

methods.name: edit_inline_keypad
methods.signature: edit_inline_keypad(self: 'darkob.Bot', chat_id: str, message_id: Union[str, int], inline_keypad: Optional[Union[Dict[str, Any], List[Dict[str, Any]]]])
methods.doc:
Edits the inline keyboard of a specific message in a chat.

Parameters:
    chat_id (str): chat_id of the chat containing the message. Must be a valid GUID (c0..., g0..., b0...) or a username (@username).
    message_id (str or int): Identifier of the message whose inline keypad should be updated. If passed as a string, it must contain only digits.
    inline_keypad (Dict[str, Any] or List): The new inline keyboard layout. Supports three formats:

        1. Simple list of strings:
            [
                ["Button 1", "Button 2"],
                ["Button 3"]
            ]
            Each inner list is a row. Buttons are strings. The type is set to "Simple" and IDs are assigned automatically starting from 100.

        2. List of tuples: (button_text, button_id, button_type)
            [
                [("راهنما", "help")],
                [("تلاش مجدد", "retry"), ("بستن", "close")],
                [("پنل مدیریت", "panel", "Simple"), ("تنظیمات", "settings", "Simple")],
                [("درباره", None), ("پشتیبانی", None)],
                [("✅ تایید", "confirm"), ("❌ لغو", "cancel"), ("🔄 بازگشت", "back")],
            ]
            Tuple structure: (text, id, type) - text: button text, id: button ID (if None, auto-assigned starting from 100), type: button type (if omitted, defaults to "Simple").

        3. Full dictionary (raw API format):
            {
                "rows": [
                    {"buttons": [{"id": "1", "button_text": "Button 1", "type": "Simple"}]},
                    {"buttons": [{"id": "2", "button_text": "Button 2", "type": "Simple"}]}
                ]
            }

        Note: Passing an empty list ([]) or None removes the inline keypad from the message.

Uses the ``editMessageKeypad`` endpoint. The reference page's
cURL sample shows ``editInlineKeypad``, but that name returns
``INVALID_INPUT: Invalid Method`` against the live API, while
``editMessageKeypad`` answers ``OK``. The prose heading is right
and the sample is stale.

Returns:
    API response with message information.

methods.name: request
methods.signature: request(self: 'darkob.Bot', method: str, endpoint: str=None, input: dict=None, **kwargs)
methods.doc:
Call the Bot API using either supported public signature.

Darkob's original form is ``request("POST", "getMe", json={})``.
Upstream 1.18 added ``request(method="getMe", input={})`` and the
positional shorthand ``request("getMe", {})``. Both are accepted so
new upstream endpoints and existing darkob applications share this
instrumented retry path.

Args:
    method: HTTP method in the original form, or API method name in
        the upstream form.
    endpoint: API method name in the original form. A dict here is
        treated as the upstream positional ``input`` payload.
    input: JSON body for the upstream call form.
    **kwargs: Extra ``aiohttp`` request arguments, including ``json``.

Returns:
    Response or dict: ``dict`` when ``Bot(as_dict=True)`` is set,
    otherwise a :class:`Response`.

methods.name: request_send_file
methods.doc:
Request an upload URL for sending a file to the server.

Parameters:
    file_type (str): Type of file to upload.
        Options: 'File', 'Image', 'Voice', 'Video', 'Music', 'Gif'.
        Defaults to 'File'.

Returns:
    str: Upload URL for the file.

Examples:
    # Get upload URL for an image
    upload_url = await bot.request_send_file(file_type="Image")

    # Then upload file using that URL
    file_id = await bot.upload_file(upload_url, "photo.jpg")

methods.name: start
methods.signature: start(self: 'darkob.Bot', poll_interval: float=0.005, webhook_url: Optional[str]=None, webhook_path: str='/wk', host: str='0.0.0.0', port: int=8080)
methods.doc:
Starts the bot, either by polling for updates or by running a webhook server.

If a `webhook_url` is provided, sets up an aiohttp web server to receive real-time updates from the Rubika API. Otherwise, falls back to a long-polling mechanism to fetch updates continuously.

Parameters:
    poll_interval (float): The interval (in seconds) between each polling operation when running in polling mode. Defaults to 0.005 seconds.
    webhook_url (str, optional): The base URL where the webhook server is accessible. If provided, the bot operates in webhook mode. Defaults to None.
    webhook_path (str): The URL path on the server to handle incoming webhook requests. Defaults to "/wk".
    host (str): The hostname or IP address to bind the webhook server. Use "0.0.0.0" to listen on all available interfaces. Defaults to "0.0.0.0".
    port (int): The port number on which the webhook server will listen. Defaults to 8080.

Returns:
    None

Adds a comment to a live stream.

Keyword arguments are canonical and unambiguous. Positional arguments
accept both legacy ``(access_token, live_id, comment)`` and upstream
``(live_id, access_token, comment)``. Upstream order is selected only
when the first argument is all digits and the second starts with
``u0`` or ``b0``; otherwise legacy order is retained, since arbitrary
strings cannot always be distinguished reliably.

    access_token (str): The access token for authentication.
    comment (str): The text of the comment.

Returns:
    The result of the API call.

methods.doc:
Edit the information of a group.

Parameters:
    group (str): The GUID or link of the group.
    title (str, optional): The new title for the group (max 60 characters).
    description (str, optional): The new description for the group (max 300 characters).
    slow_mode (str, optional): The new slow mode setting for the group.
    event_messages (bool, optional): Enable or disable event messages for the group.
    is_restricted_content (bool, optional): Restrict content (prevent screenshots and file saving).
    reactions (Union[Literal['All', 'Disable'], List[int]], optional): 'All' to enable all reactions, 'Disable' to disable all, or a list of reaction IDs to enable (e.g., [1, 2, 6, 7, 8, 23, 44]). Case-insensitive.
    chat_history_for_new_members (str, optional): The new chat history setting for new members ('Hidden' or 'Visible'). Case-insensitive.
    restricted_period (List[Dict[str, Union[List[str], str]]], optional): Time restrictions for sending messages (list of periods). Each period should contain days_of_week (list of days ['Saturday', 'Sunday', ..., 'Friday'], case-insensitive), from_time (start time in "HH:MM" format, 24-hour), and to_time (end time in "HH:MM" format, 24-hour). Can accept multiple periods as a list of dictionaries.

Returns:
    The result of the API call.

Examples:
    # Enable all reactions
    await client.edit_group_info(
        group="g0...",
        reactions="All"
    )

    # Disable all reactions
    await client.edit_group_info(
        group="g0...",
        reactions="Disable"
    )

    # Enable specific reactions
    await client.edit_group_info(
        group="g0...",
        reactions=[1, 2, 6, 7, 8, 23, 44]
    )

    # Single restricted period
    await client.edit_group_info(
        group="g0...",
        restricted_period=[{
            "days_of_week": ["Saturday", "Sunday"],
            "from_time": "00:00",
            "to_time": "06:00"
        }]
    )

    # Multiple restricted periods
    await client.edit_group_info(
        group="g0...",
        restricted_period=[
            {
                "days_of_week": ["Saturday", "Sunday", "Monday"],
                "from_time": "01:13",
                "to_time": "08:16"
            },
            {
                "days_of_week": ["Tuesday", "Wednesday"],
                "from_time": "22:00",
                "to_time": "04:00"  # Can cross midnight
            }
        ]
    )

Keyword arguments are canonical and unambiguous. Positional arguments
accept both legacy ``(access_token, live_id, comment)`` and upstream

strings cannot always be distinguished reliably.

methods.signature: edit_group_info(self: 'darkob.Messenger', group: str, title: Optional[str]=None, description: Optional[str]=None, slow_mode: Optional[str]=None, event_messages: Optional[bool]=None, is_restricted_content: Optional[bool]=None, reactions: Optional[Union[Literal['All', 'Disable'], List[int]]]=None, chat_history_for_new_members: Optional[str]=None, restricted_period: Optional[List[Dict[str, Union[List[str], str]]]]=None)
methods.doc:
Edit the information of a group.

Parameters:
    group (str): The GUID or link of the group.
    title (str, optional): The new title for the group (max 60 characters).
    description (str, optional): The new description for the group (max 300 characters).
    slow_mode (str, optional): The new slow mode setting for the group.
    event_messages (bool, optional): Enable or disable event messages for the group.
    is_restricted_content (bool, optional): Restrict content (prevent screenshots and file saving).
    reactions (Union[Literal['All', 'Disable'], List[int]], optional): 'All' to enable all reactions, 'Disable' to disable all, or a list of reaction IDs to enable (e.g., [1, 2, 6, 7, 8, 23, 44]). Case-insensitive.
    chat_history_for_new_members (str, optional): The new chat history setting for new members ('Hidden' or 'Visible'). Case-insensitive.
    restricted_period (List[Dict[str, Union[List[str], str]]], optional): Time restrictions for sending messages (list of periods). Each period should contain days_of_week (list of days ['Saturday', 'Sunday', ..., 'Friday'], case-insensitive), from_time (start time in "HH:MM" format, 24-hour), and to_time (end time in "HH:MM" format, 24-hour). Can accept multiple periods as a list of dictionaries.

Returns:
    The result of the API call.

Examples:
    # Enable all reactions
    await client.edit_group_info(
        group="g0...",
        reactions="All"
    )

    # Disable all reactions
    await client.edit_group_info(
        group="g0...",
        reactions="Disable"
    )

    # Enable specific reactions
    await client.edit_group_info(
        group="g0...",
        reactions=[1, 2, 6, 7, 8, 23, 44]
    )

    # Single restricted period
    await client.edit_group_info(
        group="g0...",
        restricted_period=[{
            "days_of_week": ["Saturday", "Sunday"],
            "from_time": "00:00",
            "to_time": "06:00"
        }]
    )

    # Multiple restricted periods
    await client.edit_group_info(
        group="g0...",
        restricted_period=[
            {
                "days_of_week": ["Saturday", "Sunday", "Monday"],
                "from_time": "01:13",
                "to_time": "08:16"
            },
            {
                "days_of_week": ["Tuesday", "Wednesday"],
                "from_time": "22:00",
                "to_time": "04:00"  # Can cross midnight
            }
        ]
    )

    types (Union[str, List[str]], optional): Type(s) of messages to filter by. Available types: text, image, video, video_message, voice, music, file, gif, live, location, poll, contact, event, edited, forwarded, sticker, me, bots, users. You can also pass a member GUID or username.
    logic (str): How to combine multiple filters. 'OR' or 'AND'. Case-insensitive. Default is 'OR'.

Returns:
    - messages: list of filtered messages.
    - count: number of filtered messages.
    - chat_guid: The GUID of the chat.
    - total_all: total messages before filtering.
    - filter_types: list of applied type filters.
    - member_guids: list of applied member GUID filters.
    - logic: the applied logic ('OR' or 'AND').

methods.signature: add_post(self: 'darkob.Rubino', file: str, caption: str='', width: int=1080, height: int=1080, thumbnail_file: Optional[str]=None, video_duration: Optional[int]=None, post_type: Literal['Simple', 'Reels']='Simple', my_profile: Optional[str]=None, location_id: Optional[str]=None, collaborators: Optional[list]=None, hide_comment_count: bool=False, hide_like_count: bool=False, show_only_close_friend: bool=False, hide_share_count: bool=False)
methods.doc:
Add a new post to a profile.

Parameters:
    file (str): Local path to the main picture or video file.
    caption (str, optional): The post caption. Defaults to empty string.
    width (int, optional): The post width in pixels. Default is 1080. For 'Simple' use square or landscape dimensions; for 'Reels' use vertical (e.g. 1080x1920).
    height (int, optional): The post height in pixels. Default is 1080.
    thumbnail_file (str, optional): Local path to a separate thumbnail/cover image. For pictures, defaults to re-uploading the main file. For videos, if not provided, the cover is extracted from the video using MediaThumbnail.
    video_duration (int, optional): Video duration in seconds. Required for videos when MediaThumbnail is not available (optional libraries missing).
    post_type (Literal['Simple', 'Reels']): The post type. Case-insensitive. Default is 'Simple'.
    my_profile (str, optional): The profile that uploads and owns the post. Defaults to self.profile_id.
    location_id (str, optional): The location ID for the post.
    collaborators (list, optional): List of collaborator profile IDs or usernames.
    hide_comment_count (bool, optional): Hide the comment count on the post. Default is False.
    hide_like_count (bool, optional): Hide the like count on the post. Default is False.
    show_only_close_friend (bool, optional): Show the post only to close friends. Default is False.
    hide_share_count (bool, optional): Hide the share count on the post. Default is False.

Returns:
    The response data.

Raises:
    InvalidInput: If required optional libraries are missing for video processing without `thumbnail_file`/`video_duration`, or if the file is invalid.

Examples:
    # Simple square picture post
    await client.add_post(
        file="photo.jpg",
        caption="Hello world!"
    )

    # Reels video post (cover and duration auto-extracted)
    await client.add_post(
        file="reel.mp4",
        caption="A cool reel",
        post_type="Reels",
        width=1080,
        height=1920
    )

    # Reels video with explicit cover and duration in seconds (no optional libraries needed)
    await client.add_post(
        file="reel.mp4",
        caption="Manual cover",
        post_type="Reels",
        width=1080,
        height=1920,
        thumbnail_file="cover.jpg",
        video_duration=15
    )

methods.doc:
Create a new page (profile).

Parameters:
    name (str): The display name of the page.
    username (str): The username for the page.
    profile_status (Literal['Public', 'Private']): The page visibility. Case-insensitive. Default is 'Public'.
    profile_type (Literal['Business', 'Personal', 'Creator'], optional): The page type. Case-insensitive.
    bio (str, optional): The page bio.
    email (str, optional): The email contact.
    phone (str, optional): The phone contact.
    website (str, optional): The website contact.
    avatar_file (str, optional): Local path to the avatar main image. If 'avatar_thumbnail' is not provided, the main file is uploaded again as the thumbnail.
    avatar_thumbnail (str, optional): Local path to the avatar thumbnail image.

Returns:
    The response data.

Examples:
    # Minimal page
    await client.create_page(
        name="My Page",
        username="mypage"
    )

    # Private business page with bio
    await client.create_page(
        name="My Business",
        username="mybusiness",
        profile_status="Private",
        profile_type="Business",
        bio="We sell stuff"
    )

    # Page with contacts
    await client.create_page(
        name="My Store",
        username="mystore",
        profile_type="Business",
        email="info@example.com",
        phone="+989123456789",
        website="https://example.com"
    )

    # Page with avatar (thumbnail auto-uploaded from main if omitted)
    await client.create_page(
        name="My Page",
        username="mypage",
        avatar_file="avatar.jpg"
    )

    # Page with explicit avatar thumbnail
    await client.create_page(
        name="My Page",
        username="mypage",
        avatar_file="avatar.jpg",
        avatar_thumbnail="avatar_thumb.jpg"

methods.doc:
Get posts related to a given post.

Parameters:
    location (Literal['Explore', 'SuggestedPost', 'ShowPost']): The context where related posts are shown. Case-insensitive.
    post_id (str, optional): The ID of the reference post. Defaults to None.
    target_profile (str, optional): The profile ID or username that owns the post. Defaults to None.
    track_id (str, optional): A tracking ID. Defaults to None.
    limit (int, optional): The maximum number of posts to return. Defaults to None (server default).
    start_id (str, optional): The starting post ID for pagination. Defaults to None.
    post_position (dict, optional): The position of the post in the grid, with 'row' (int) and 'column' (int). Defaults to None.
    my_profile (str, optional): The profile that requests. Defaults to self.profile_id.

Returns:
    The response data.

Examples:
    # Explore related posts
    await client.get_related_posts(
        location="Explore",
        limit=10,
        my_profile="MAXRubikaTest"
    )

    # Suggested posts after viewing a post
    await client.get_related_posts(
        location="SuggestedPost",
        post_id="6ae61abdfc4eff521f9f0448",
        target_profile="Online_User",
        limit=10,
        my_profile="MAXRubikaTest"
    )

    # Related posts shown on a post page
    await client.get_related_posts(
        location="ShowPost",
        post_id="6ae61abdfc4eff521f9f0448",
        target_profile="Online_User",
        track_id='{"l": "SharePost"}',
        my_profile="MAXRubikaTest"
    )

    # With post position in the grid
    await client.get_related_posts(
        location="Explore",
        post_id="6ae61abdfc4eff521f9f0448",
        target_profile="Online_User",
        post_position={"row": 1, "column": 2},
        my_profile="MAXRubikaTest"
    )

methods.name: track_client_metrics
methods.signature: track_client_metrics(self: 'darkob.Rubino', network: Literal['WiFi', '2G', '3G', '4G', '5G', 'Offline'], metrics: List[Dict], my_profile: Optional[str]=None)
methods.doc:
Track client metrics for analytics.

Parameters:
    network (Literal['WiFi', '2G', '3G', '4G', '5G', 'Offline']): The current network type. Case-insensitive.
    metrics (List[Dict]): List of metric entries. Each entry must contain 'type' ('LoadingFile' or 'UploadingFile') and the corresponding data ('loading_file_data' for LoadingFile, 'uploading_file_data' for UploadingFile).
    my_profile (str, optional): The profile that reports. Defaults to self.profile_id.

Returns:
    The response data.

Examples:
    # Upload metrics for a successful image upload
    await client.track_client_metrics(
        network="WiFi",
        metrics=[
            {
                "type": "UploadingFile",
                "uploading_file_data": {
                    "status": "Success",
                    "media_type": "Image",
                    "file_size_bytes": 123456,
                    "upload_ms": 1500,
                    "convert_ms": 200,
                    "publish_ms": 300,
                    "total_ms": 2000,
                    "attempts_count": 1,
                    "media_count": 1,
                    "video_count": 0,
                    "is_foreground": True,
                    "is_streaming_upload": False,
                    "stalled": False
                }
            }
        ],
        my_profile="MAXRubikaTest"
    )

    # Upload metrics for a failed video upload
    await client.track_client_metrics(
        network="4G",
        metrics=[
            {
                "type": "UploadingFile",
                "uploading_file_data": {
                    "status": "Failed",
                    "media_type": "Video",
                    "file_size_bytes": 5242880,
                    "upload_ms": 12000,
                    "total_ms": 15000,
                    "attempts_count": 3,
                    "media_count": 1,
                    "video_count": 1,
                    "video_duration_ms": 30000,
                    "is_foreground": True,
                    "stalled": True,
                    "stalled_stage": "UploadingFile",
                    "failed_stage": "UploadingFile",
                    "error_type": "NetworkError",
                    "error_detail": "Connection timed out"
                }
            }
        ],
        my_profile="MAXRubikaTest"
    )

    # Loading metrics for a video viewed in feed
    await client.track_client_metrics(
        network="WiFi",
        metrics=[
            {
                "type": "LoadingFile",
                "loading_file_data": {
                    "view_type": "Reels",
                    "downloaded_bytes": 1048576,
                    "loading_count": 1,
                    "reached_first_frame": True,
                    "startup_ms": 500,
                    "startup_buffering_ms": 200,
                    "rebuffer_ms": 100,
                    "watch_ms": 8000
                }
            }
        ],
        my_profile="MAXRubikaTest"
    )

    # Multiple metrics in one request
    await client.track_client_metrics(
        network="WiFi",
        metrics=[
            {
                "type": "UploadingFile",
                "uploading_file_data": {
                    "status": "Success",
                    "media_type": "Image",
                    "file_size_bytes": 200000,
                    "upload_ms": 1000,
                    "total_ms": 1500,
                    "attempts_count": 1
                }
            },
            {
                "type": "LoadingFile",
                "loading_file_data": {
                    "view_type": "Simple",
                    "downloaded_bytes": 500000,
                    "reached_first_frame": True,
                    "startup_ms": 300,
                    "watch_ms": 4000
                }
            }
        ],
        my_profile="MAXRubikaTest"
    )

methods.name: update_page
methods.signature: update_page(self: 'darkob.Rubino', name: Optional[str]=None, username: Optional[str]=None, profile_status: Optional[Literal['Public', 'Private']]=None, profile_type: Optional[Literal['Business', 'Personal', 'Creator']]=None, bio: Optional[str]=None, email: Optional[str]=None, phone: Optional[str]=None, website: Optional[str]=None, avatar_file: Optional[str]=None, avatar_thumbnail: Optional[str]=None, delete_avatar: bool=False, my_profile: Optional[str]=None)
methods.doc:
Update a page (profile).

Only the fields that are provided (not None) will be updated. Contact fields are merged: providing an empty string removes that contact type, while other existing contacts are preserved.

Parameters:
    name (str, optional): The new display name.
    username (str, optional): The new username.
    profile_status (Literal['Public', 'Private'], optional): The new visibility. Case-insensitive.
    profile_type (Literal['Business', 'Personal', 'Creator'], optional): The new page type. Case-insensitive.
    bio (str, optional): The new bio.
    email (str, optional): The new email contact. If empty string, removes the email contact.
    phone (str, optional): The new phone contact. If empty string, removes the phone contact.
    website (str, optional): The new website contact. If empty string, removes the website contact.
    avatar_file (str, optional): Local path to the new avatar main image. If 'avatar_thumbnail' is not provided, the main file is uploaded again as the thumbnail. Cannot be used together with 'delete_avatar'.
    avatar_thumbnail (str, optional): Local path to the new avatar thumbnail image.
    delete_avatar (bool, optional): If True, removes the current avatar. Cannot be used together with 'avatar_file'. Default is False.
    my_profile (str, optional): The profile to update. Defaults to self.profile_id.

Returns:
    The response data.

Examples:
    # Update name only
    await client.update_page(name="New Name")

    # Update bio and status
    await client.update_page(
        bio="New bio",
        profile_status="Private"
    )

    # Update contacts individually
    await client.update_page(
        email="info@example.com",
        phone="9986",
        website="https://example.com"
    )

    # Remove a single contact
    await client.update_page(email="")

    # Update avatar (thumbnail auto-uploaded from main if omitted)
    await client.update_page(
        avatar_file="new_avatar.jpg"
    )

    # Update avatar with explicit thumbnail
    await client.update_page(
        avatar_file="new_avatar.jpg",
        avatar_thumbnail="new_avatar_thumb.jpg"
    )

    # Delete the current avatar
    await client.update_page(delete_avatar=True)

methods.name: upload_file

Register views for feed posts.
